enonce.texte: Read the following statements about the A2/B1 English test format. Choose the correct answer for each question.

questions.texte: How many parts does the A2/B1 test usually have?

sousQuestions.texte: The A2/B1 test usually has 4 parts: Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking.

questions.texte: What does the Listening part of the test assess?
questions.reponse: Your ability to understand spoken English

sousQuestions.texte: The Listening part assesses your ability to understand spoken English in everyday situations.
sousQuestions.reponse: Your ability to understand spoken English

questions.texte: What does the Speaking part of the test assess?
questions.reponse: Your ability to communicate orally in English

sousQuestions.texte: The Speaking part assesses your ability to communicate orally in English on familiar topics.
sousQuestions.reponse: Your ability to communicate orally in English

intitule: Grammar Review: Present, Past, and Future

enonce.texte: Complete the sentences with the correct tense (present simple, present continuous, past simple, future with 'will' or 'going to').

questions.texte: I ______ (work) as a teacher. (present simple - routine)
She ______ (study) at the library right now. (present continuous - action in progress)
We ______ (visit) our grandmother yesterday. (past simple)
They ______ (travel) to Douala next week. (future with 'going to')
I think it ______ (rain) tomorrow. (future with 'will' - prediction)

enonce.texte: Identify the tense used in each sentence.

questions.texte: 'I go to school every day.' - What tense is this?

sousQuestions.texte: a) Present simple  b) Present continuous  c) Past simple  d) Future

questions.texte: 'She is reading a book now.' - What tense is this?

sousQuestions.texte: a) Present simple  b) Present continuous  c) Past simple  d) Future

questions.texte: 'They visited the market yesterday.' - What tense is this?

sousQuestions.texte: a) Present simple  b) Present continuous  c) Past simple  d) Future

questions.texte: 'We are going to start a new project.' - What tense is this?

sousQuestions.texte: a) Present simple  b) Present continuous  c) Past simple  d) Future (going to)

enonce.texte: Prepare a short self-introduction (5-7 sentences) for the speaking part of the test. Include your name, age, origin, occupation, family, and one hobby.

questions.texte: Write your self-introduction.
questions.reponse: Réponse personnelle (exemple: My name is Jean. I am 22 years old. I am from Douala. I am a student. I have one brother and two sisters. I like playing football.)

enonce.texte:
Write a short paragraph (8-10 sentences) about one of the following topics:

  • Your daily routine
  • Your last holiday
  • Your future plans

questions.texte: Write a paragraph on one of the topics above.
questions.reponse: Réponse personnelle (exemple: I wake up at 6am every day. I have breakfast and go to school. I study English and French. I finish school at 3pm. I go home and help my mother. I watch TV in the evening. I go to bed at 10pm.)

enonce.texte:
Read the text and answer the questions.

Text: My name is Fatima. I live in Bamenda with my family. I am 22 years old and I work as a nurse at the local hospital. I work from Monday to Friday. I start work at 7am and finish at 4pm. In my free time, I like reading novels and listening to music. On weekends, I visit my grandmother in the village. I am happy with my life.

questions.texte: Where does Fatima live?
What is Fatima's profession?
What does Fatima do on weekends?
questions.reponse: She visits her grandmother in the village.

questions.texte: Explain how Fatima feels about her life.
questions.reponse: She is happy with her life.

enonce.texte:
Your teacher will give you spoken directions to find a place in town. Follow the directions and answer the questions.

Directions: 'Go straight, turn left at the bank, then go straight again. The market is on your right.'

questions.texte: What do you do first?
Where is the market located?

enonce.texte: Choose the correct option to complete each sentence.

questions.texte: She ______ to school every day.

sousQuestions.texte: a) go  b) goes  c) going  d) went

questions.texte: They ______ watching a movie now.

sousQuestions.texte: a) is  b) am  c) are  d) be

questions.texte: I ______ visit my grandmother yesterday.

sousQuestions.texte: a) visit  b) visited  c) visiting  d) will visit

questions.texte: We ______ to Douala next week.

sousQuestions.texte: a) travel  b) travelled  c) are going to travel  d) will travelling

enonce.texte:
Prepare a short presentation (8-10 sentences) in English on one of the following topics:

  • 'My Country Cameroon'
  • 'My Future Plans'
  • 'A Memorable Event in My Life'

questions.texte: Write your presentation.
questions.reponse: Réponse personnelle (exemple: My country is Cameroon. It is a beautiful country in Central Africa. The capital is Yaoundé. The largest city is Douala. We have many cultures and languages. We eat delicious food like ndolé and fufu. I love my country and I am proud to be Cameroonian.)

enonce.texte: Your teacher will ask you some questions. Write your spontaneous responses.

questions.texte: What is your name?
How are you today?
What do you do in your free time?
questions.reponse: In my free time, I like reading books and listening to music.

questions.texte: What are your plans for the weekend?
questions.reponse: I am going to visit my family this weekend.
